rule: slots = bookable slots in 14 days; if slots >= 2 then raw = 20 + min(slots - 2,18) * (80/18) else raw = 0; points = raw/100 * 20
notes: Zero or one slot earns zero; cap reached at 20 slots

rule: Years in Practice: 0-2 years raw 50 then +10 per existing experience tier capped at raw 100 for 20+ years
notes: Every Therapist permission status uses this scale; missing field earns zero

notes: Every Nurses & More permission status uses this scale; missing field earns zero

rule: Completed Coaching Hours: 0-500 hours raw 40 then +10 per existing experience tier capped at raw 100 for 3000+ hours
notes: Missing field earns zero

rule: Completed Practice Hours: 0-500 hours raw 40 then +10 per existing experience tier capped at raw 100 for 2000+ hours
notes: Missing field earns zero

rule: Three binary groups: current public License/Registration/Permit; public Academic Degree; current public Professional Certificate. 0 groups=0; 1=10; 2=15; 3=20
notes: Count groups not records; memberships and status-only claims do not count; under the unified credential record a migrated record not yet edited by the provider counts as its legacy source row did (v3.3 amendment, October 2026)

rule: v=included rating count; R=official provider mean; m=5; C=platform mean; weighted=(v/(v+m))*R+(m/(v+m))*C; v=0 uses C; points=min(20,max(0,(weighted-1)*5))
source: Official Review System average and count
notes: Default Sort never reclassifies reviews

rule: 10 when Real-Time Audio Translation is enabled and 0 when disabled
notes: Default-on and awarded uniformly across all SERPs

rule: availability + experience + credential_breadth + reviews + translation
notes: Applied within tier

rule: Named-provider Talk Now ring answered from 0 through 30 seconds
notes: Eligible for Reliability Score

rule: Named-provider Talk Now ring answered after 30 seconds and before 60-second timeout
notes: Eligible for Reliability Score

rule: Named-provider Talk Now ring not answered before 60-second timeout
notes: Eligible for Reliability Score

rule: 30-day eligible answer-point average * 0.90 + Session Completion Rate * 0.10
source: Eligible named-provider Talk Now events and accepted sessions reaching in_progress
notes: Fan-out non-answers are operational-only and excluded

rule: Active Talk Now provider with at least five eligible events and Reliability Score 90-100
notes: Applies only within Tier 1 or Tier 3

rule: Active Talk Now provider below 90 OR fewer than five eligible events
notes: Insufficient-history providers are neutral

rule: Talk Now off never enabled or suspended
notes: Base score alone in Tier 2 or Tier 4

rule: Two misses in a rolling seven-day window
notes: Talk Now suspension only

rule: Five incidents in 30 days triggers 30-day pause and Reliability Recertification
notes: No added 0.70 multiplier or 60-day recovery penalty

rule: Descending: most recently updated profile first
notes: Applied after final score within tier

rule: Ascending for deterministic stability
notes: Applied after profile update timestamp

rule: No provider may buy a score tier or position; Verification Fee does not guarantee status and cannot be bid
notes: Verified outcome may affect tier as disclosed

rule: Algorithm orders eligible providers and does not select a provider or judge clinical quality
notes: Client choice filters semantic relevance and explicit sorts may override default order
